|rulings=* [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon]] gets the +1 bonus for [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] firing.<ref name="scomp" />
* During initiation of this Interrupt, a player chooses a weapon to fire, not a target to fire at. Opponent's response (such as [[Sense]]) is played before the target to fire at is chosen. A response to the weapon targeting (e.g. [[Force Field]]) is played slightly later, after that target is chosen.
* [[Surprise]] may retarget to a different weapon that can fire, but cannot choose a new target to fire at (because no target to fire at has been selected yet).
